title: VulnerableMint.sol

findings.title: Verification key comes from the caller
findings.evidence: The leaf checked by verifyProofAggregation depends on parameter `vkHash` (bytes32). An attacker passes the vkHash of any circuit they wrote and a real zkVerify receipt for it.
findings.fix: Pin the vkHash (immutable, set in the constructor) and build the statement from it. See PinnedZkVerifyConsumer.

findings.title: Receipts can be replayed
findings.evidence: claim checks a receipt but records nothing (no statement or nullifier mapping is written), so the same receipt works again.
findings.fix: Record the statement hash (or a nullifier bound in the public inputs) and refuse it the second time.

findings.title: zkVerify domain comes from the caller
findings.evidence: `domainId` is a parameter: the receipt may come from any aggregation domain.

attack.summary: 2 of 2 attacks worked on VulnerableMint: forged receipt mints; replay mints twice.
